name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Two new features. (1) Browse & Download: a new tab lets an admin browse any connected server's full catalog by library, independent of the whole-library sync the Libraries tab already does, and pull individual items down to this server's disk on demand - useful for grabbing one title without mapping and syncing a friend's entire library for it. Works against both a Jellyfin peer (native Peer/Items) and a Plex source (its own catalog provider); downloads land in the existing 'Federation Downloads' library. (2) Prefer higher-quality copies: an opt-in Advanced setting (off by default) that checks your own locally-owned movies/episodes against the matching copy on a federated friend's server (matched the same way library-merge dedup already matches 'the same movie' across servers) and, every time the config page loads, shows a review list of any with a meaningfully better remote copy - clearly higher resolution, or higher bitrate at the same resolution. Nothing is ever removed automatically: the list is a plain checklist (select all, some, or none) and Apply downloads the better copy first, only removing the old local one after the replacement is confirmed safely on disk. 328 tests, all green.
